author: Jennifer Cole
text: These guys are AWESOME!! Super fair pricing, care and concern for the customer, and they remembered our pets name from the last time we used them!  These guys are great at giving you an honest assessment and educating you on any of your questions and the why behind the problem.  If you need a plumber, you need the local guys!!

author: Anna McConnell
text: Do not hesitate to work with this crew. Besides being extremely friendly and kind with my toddler, they came in under the price of a competitor and did not raise my total when my very old home needed specialty fixtures. They have customer needs at heart! I couldn’t be happier with our finished product and their service!

author: John Kennedy
text: Excellent service, super  knowledge, incredibly professional. These guys knocked it out of the park. Best price and did what they said they would do. As a listing real estate agent I’d put my neck out for my clients and refer Local Guys Plumbing. Thank you for your time and rapid response.

author: Sandy Stoltz
text:
We first used them a couple years ago when they hooked our new fridge to water. The second was Saturday evening, they came out because we had a backup in our shower. They came within 45 minutes or less of us calling them. They are very professional and very nice couple. They are not here to rip you off but will get the job done. We highly recommend them.
Thank you!
Tom and Sandy

author: joe materne
text: I had my leaky faucet fixed! Fantastic communication! And very easy to work with.
